rationale: Phase 2 blast-radius code meets F1/F4/F10 as written: event_id required (empty/missing 400, 0 rows), UniqueConstraint (site_id, event_id) named uq_events_site_event_id with matching ON CONFLICT, no leftover ORM uq_events_event_id, no NOT NULL, alembic revises b7e3c9a4f215 (backfill then drop then unique), scheduler still 24 add_job with retention_purge next_run_time +75s, F4 tests POST with browser User-Agent. Independent prod SQL on hylcleqxlkdblibpdhhm: alembic_version=b7e3c9a4f215, only uq_events_event_id, 682 NULL event_ids — cook did not apply to Supabase. Concerns: DSN guard allows unknown APP_ENV (prod/staging/typo) against remote DSN; deploy must migrate before new ingest code or ON CONFLICT 500s; downgrade recreates global unique and cannot undo backfill.
nonBlockingFindings: F10 DSN guard is allow-listed on local|development|test|ci only. APP_ENV=prod, staging, or a typo like produciton plus a remote DSN is allowed. config.py treats unknown env as production-strict; the alembic guard does the opposite. Fail-closed fix: abort unless (env in nonprod AND host local) OR (env == 'production').

Deploy ordering: new ingest uses on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=[site_id, event_id]). Prod still has only uq_events_event_id. Shipping API before c3f6a9d1e8b2 makes ingest raise (no matching unique). Apply migration first, then deploy code. Not expand-contract.

Migration downgrade drops uq_events_site_event_id then recreates global unique on event_id. After cross-site reuse that CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fails. Backfill is not reversed. Do not downgrade prod after F1 traffic.
PostgreSQL UNIQUE (site_id, event_id) still allows multiple NULLs per site. Ingest requires the field; column stays nullable by design. Residual until the deferred NOT NULL phase.
DSN guard does not treat ::1 or docker DNS names (postgres, host.docker.internal) as local. Intentional vs the localhost-only AC; operators must run alembic from the host against localhost:5433.
event_id min_length=1 does not strip: a single space passes. Empty string is tested and 400s. Low practical risk.
F10 retention deleted=0 is code-true (job always logs **result including deleted=0). No runtime proof in this cook that the job fired after boot. AST proves next_run_time only.
Execute-agent pytest 85+56 is not independently re-run by this review. Prod SQL and static unique/ON CONFLICT/nullable/revision checks are independent.
